honing_confound: Predator's Crit Damage bonus (+40% in Burst Mode per source) compounds with gear crit stats. The rapid-exhaust loop requires Swiftness stat investment that scales with gear honing tier. Tier standing reflects T4 meta where Predator's consistent Burst Mode uptime is valued.

delivery.evidence: All Slayer skills are melee greatsword attacks. Brutal Impact, Volcanic Eruption, Flame Deathblade, Guillotine, Wild Stomp are the key skills. Back-attack positioning required (+10% crit +5% dmg).

footprint.evidence: Greatsword sweeps hit in frontal arcs and small radii. Wild Stomp creates a small AoE at target location. No wide-zone coverage.

geo_text: Slayer is a high-mobility melee DPS relative to other Warriors. Predator identity: maintain Burst Mode for as long as possible while managing Fatigue stacks. All delivery at melee range. Back-attack positioning is a core constraint — must circle to rear of boss for optimal damage.

control.evidence: No primary CC in Predator identity. Wild Stomp is used as counter skill and synergy applicator. Primary identity is sustained DPS, not control.

defense.evidence: Slayer has good mobility (dashes) which provides effective dodge rather than mitigation. Burst Mode grants no significant defensive bonus in Predator identity. Identity is glass-forward — speed over tankiness.

economy.resource_verbatim: Fury Meter (fills via attacks; depletes in Burst Mode)
economy.builder_source: All attacks generate Fury. Predator: on-hit recovery of +10% Fury per hit (1s cooldown) during Burst Mode. Fatigue stack accumulation increases Fury depletion rate by 10% per stack — the identity creates a tension between Fury regeneration and faster depletion.
economy.plain_text: PREDATOR LOOP: Enter Burst Mode (full Fury) → gain +20% atk speed, +30% crit rate, +40% crit damage (kb from search; +48% per Maxroll earlier — slight discrepancy, using +40% as more conservative). Fatigue stacks build every 3s in Burst Mode (+10% Fury consumption per stack). Burst ends naturally or via exhaust. BUT: each Fatigue stack ALSO reduces Exhaustion duration by 1s → rapid Fatigue cycling = shorter Exhaustion = faster re-entry. Bloodlust (Z skill) is DISABLED in Predator. The identity removes the 'manual burst activation' and replaces it with a rapid self-cycling exhaust loop.

element.evidence: Slayer greatsword skills deal Physical damage. Volcanic Eruption has a fire visual but likely Physical damage type in LA's system.

movement.evidence: Several Slayer skills include movement components (Volcanic Eruption has a dash-in component). Swiftness stat investment increases attack speed + movement speed. Relative to other Warriors, Slayer has better mobility. Still rooted during heavy skill animations.

range.evidence: All melee range. Forward dash attacks extend slightly.

tempo.evidence: Predator is the sustained identity: Burst Mode is maintained near-continuously via rapid Fatigue cycling. No long downtime phase. Contrast with Punisher (deliberate 30s burst windows).

amp.value: Burst Mode: +20% atk speed, +30% crit rate, +40% crit damage; Fatigue reduces exhaust duration (sustains Burst uptime)
amp.evidence: Search results: '+40% Crit Damage during Burst Mode' (per mobalytics/icy-veins sources); Maxroll earlier noted '+48%' — discrepancy; both sourced but lower value used as conservative estimate. Sources: icy-veins.com Predator guide.

commitment.evidence: Volcanic Eruption (charge attack), Guillotine (charge strike) are wind-up skills. Brutal Impact and some quick slashes are fast. Mix of instant and wind-up commitment in the skill set.

mechanics_notes: 1) Predator disables Bloodlust (Z skill) — this is the IDENTITY SKILL, which in Punisher identity is a major damage tool. Predator essentially trades the burst-identity-skill for sustained crit damage uptime. This is a unique design: the engraving REMOVES a tool to define a different loop structure. 2) Back-attack discipline: Predator's sustained Burst Mode encourages continuous melee engagement, making back-attack positioning discipline critical. A class that must always be behind the boss = high mechanical demand. 3) Slayer is the female-coded counterpart to Berserker (same base archetype, different model). The two classes share conceptual heritage but Slayer's Bloodlust system is cleaner than Berserker's Fury Meter — Bloodlust has a visual design cue (blood fill) that Berserker lacks.
stabilization_patch: Predator was the dominant Slayer identity from day one of global launch due to back-attack crit synergy.
tier_standing_current: A-tier (consistent across 2023-2026). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: performance scales with crit gear investment; T4 meta benefits Predator's crit damage model significantly.
rank1_upgrade_notes: Slayer released June 2023 (KR April 2023). Some early mechanics knowledge is kb-level; Icy Veins and Maxroll guides used as Rank-1 sources for live verification.
sources_used: kb: training knowledge for June 2023 launch-era mechanics

honing_confound: Punisher's burst window damage scales with Specialization stat (enhances charge skill damage + awakening). Specialization scales with gear honing. 30-second burst window length is fixed but damage output within it is honing-gated.

delivery.evidence: Same melee greatsword skills. Punisher emphasizes 'slow charge skills' via Specialization stat. Bloody Rush (Z in Punisher) is a charge-dash at target with stab.

footprint.evidence: Same frontal arc/small radius. Bloody Rush travels to target.

geo_text: Same spatial identity as Predator Slayer — melee back-attack oriented. Key difference: Punisher has deliberate 30-second burst windows rather than continuous uptime. Outside burst = building Fury; inside burst = spending all damage in 30s window using Bloodlust (Z) as primary tool.

control.evidence: Same as Predator. Bloodlust has high Stagger + Destruction ratings (the most valuable boss-mechanic outputs) but CC is not the identity.

defense.evidence: Same profile as Predator — dodge via mobility. Punisher does not modify defensive profile significantly.

economy.builder_source: Normal skills fill Fury. Punisher does NOT disable Bloodlust — instead ENHANCES it (Z skill available in Burst Mode). No Fatigue stacks in Punisher — Burst Mode runs for full 30s then exits without exhaustion.
economy.plain_text: BUILD: Fill Fury via normal skill rotation. BURST: Activate Burst Mode (Z to enter). 30-second window: all damage focused, use Bloodlust (Z) as primary DPS tool during window (+20% crit, highest Stagger/Destruction). EXHAUST-FREE EXIT: Burst ends without exhaustion → Fury re-build begins immediately. Simple build-release rhythm with Bloodlust as the identity skill in each window.

movement.evidence: Same mobility profile. Bloody Rush includes a dash-to-target.

range.evidence: Bloody Rush travels to target within ~6m. Standard melee range.

tempo.evidence: Punisher is the burst identity: deliberate 30-second burst windows with Bloodlust as the burst skill. Predictable build-release rhythm.

amp.value: Burst Mode: +25% damage; Bloodlust (Z) +20% crit rate; no exhaustion on exit
amp.evidence: Confirmed from search results: 'Punisher: During Burst Mode, all damage +25% and Punisher Bloodlust (Z) crit rate +20%, Burst Mode duration -50%, and when Burst Mode ends, exhaustion is not applied.' Note: duration -50% = 30s Burst becomes 15s effectively? Or -50% natural duration meaning Burst is shorter but exhaust is gone. Sources confirm exhaust-free exit.

commitment.evidence: Bloody Rush (dash-stab) is a wind-up/channel. Slow charge skills via Specialization = longer animation locks.

mechanics_notes: 1) Punisher is the canonical 'build-release' burst identity for Slayer — the design philosophy is EXPLICIT in the name (you are the punisher during the burst window). 2) Bloodlust skill (Z) has the highest Stagger + Destruction ratings in the Slayer kit — making Punisher identity the better Destroyer/Disruptor identity for raid mechanics. In LA, Destruction (Part Break) and Stagger are support functions parties value. Punisher Slayer contributes these better than Predator Slayer. 3) Punisher is MORE consistent for players unfamiliar with greedy back-attack discipline — the 30-second burst window is more forgiving than Predator's Fatigue management. This 'lower mechanical ceiling but more consistent floor' dynamic is a good design pattern. 4) Bloody Rush as the identity skill has a specific 'stab to back and away' animation that requires close range to execute — the Z skill IS back-position dependent.
stabilization_patch: Punisher stabilized as the 'alternative' to Predator from launch — preferred by casual players, discouraged for endgame optimization.
tier_standing_release: B-tier at launch (less dominant than Predator)
tier_standing_current: B/C-tier. HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: Punisher is competitive at lower honing tiers where Predator's crit stat dependency is harder to meet; at T4 ceiling, Predator's sustained crit output surpasses Punisher.
rank1_upgrade_notes: Same as Predator — June 2023 class; Icy Veins + Maxroll used.
sources_used: kb: training knowledge for June 2023 launch-era mechanics
